عَتَدٌ : see عَتِيدٌ. ―
-b2- [Hence,] فَرَسٌ عَتَدٌ, as also ↓ عَتِدٌ , A horse made ready, or prepared, for running; (S, O, L, K;) of strong make; quick in leaping, or springing; not incongruous, unsound, faulty, or weak, in make; nor lax, or uncompact: (L:) or strong, and perfect in make: (ISk, S, O, K:) or that performs run after run: (O:) or made ready, or prepared, for riding: and applied alike to a male and to a female. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
